values.title: RESPONSIBILITY
values.description: We take pride in our work, own our responsibilities, acknowledge mistakes, and take corrective action without deflecting blame.

values.title: TEAMWORK
values.description: We work together and draw on each other’s strengths to reach shared goals.

values.title: RECOGNITION
values.description: We notice and celebrate each other’s contributions and successes.

values.title: ADAPTABILITY
values.description: We adjust when circumstances change and look for ways through new challenges.

values.title: GROWTH
values.description: We develop our skills and learn from challenges together.

values.title: INCLUSIVITY
values.description: We welcome different perspectives and treat everyone with respect.

values.title: CLARITY
values.description: We communicate clearly and give respectful, constructive feedback when concerns arise.

values.title: DEDICATION
values.description: We stay committed to our goals and follow through on our promises, even when obstacles arise.

values.title: BALANCE
values.description: We balance our workloads with time for our health and lives outside work.

values.title: CREATIVITY
values.description: We make space to explore new ideas and different ways of working.

values.title: EMPATHY
values.description: We listen to understand, treating each other with kindness and compassion.

values.title: EXCELLENCE
values.description: We aim for high standards in our work and look for ways to improve it.

values.title: INTEGRITY
values.description: We act in alignment with our values, even when it’s difficult or inconvenient.

values.title: LEADERSHIP
values.description: We take responsibility, set direction, and help the team move towards its goals.

values.title: OPENNESS
values.description: We share ideas, perspectives, and information openly with one another.

values.title: POSITIVITY
values.description: We encourage one another and look for solutions when problems arise.

values.title: RESILIENCE
values.description: We recover from setbacks and learn from them together.

values.title: SAFETY
values.description: We make it safe for everyone to speak up, be themselves, and take risks.

values.title: SUPPORT
values.description: We help one another with guidance, encouragement, and practical assistance.

values.title: ACCOUNTABILITY
values.description: We take ownership of our actions and follow through on our commitments.

values.title: TRUST
values.description: We build mutual trust by being dependable, honest, and supportive.

values.title: TRANSPARENCY
values.description: We communicate openly and honestly so everyone has the information they need.

values.title: INNOVATION
values.description: We question established ways of working and try new approaches to solve problems.

values.title: HUMILITY
values.description: We acknowledge our limitations, remain open to feedback, and learn from others.

values.title: COURAGE
values.description: We face challenges, take considered risks, and step outside our comfort zones.

values.title: FOCUS
values.description: We keep our priorities in view and limit distractions as we work towards our goals.

values.title: PERSISTENCE
values.description: We stay determined and consistent, even when facing challenges or setbacks.

values.title: STANDARDS
values.description: We hold ourselves and each other to high standards in our work.

values.title: FLEXIBILITY
values.description: We adjust how we work to meet changing needs and challenges.

values.title: OPTIMISM
values.description: We look for reasons to stay hopeful and encourage one another through difficult times.

values.title: COMMUNITY
values.description: We build a sense of belonging and shared purpose within our team and beyond.

values.title: ENERGY
values.description: We bring enthusiasm to our work and share it with others.

values.title: ALIGNMENT
values.description: We connect our individual work to the team’s shared objectives.

values.title: RESOURCEFULNESS
values.description: We make the most of available resources and find ways around limitations.

values.title: EQUITY
values.description: We treat people fairly and work to give everyone equal opportunities to succeed.
